mapper.insert: INSERT INTO electronic_approval ( title, doc_type, approval_status, draft_dt, drafter_id, drafter_name, department_name ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{docType}, #{approvalStatus}, #{draftDate}, #{drafterId}, #{drafterName}, #{departmentName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_approval SET approval_status = 'COMPLETE', approve_dt = NOW() WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE electronic_approval SET approval_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE electronic_approval SET approval_status = 'HOLD' WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'

choose.when: ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipient_line rli WHERE rli.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rli.receiver_id = #{employeeId} )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE

SELECT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_id AS docId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate, ea.approve_dt AS approveDate, ea.drafter_id AS drafterId, ea.drafter_name AS drafterName, ea.department_name AS departmentName, COALESCE( ( SELECT al.read_dt FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY al.approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT rf.read_dt FROM reference_line rf WHERE rf.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rf.referencer_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY rf.reference_id ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT rc.read_dt FROM recipient_line rc WHERE rc.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rc.receiver_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY rc.recipient_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS readDate FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE
ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status <> 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS allCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'TEMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS draftCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'HOLD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS inProgressCount, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS rejectedCount FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.sql:
ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.approval_status <> 'COMPLETE'
AND ea.approval_status = 'TEMP'
AND ea.approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'HOLD')
AND ea.approval_status = 'REJECTED'
AND ( ea.doc_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ea.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE

SELECT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_id AS docId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate, ea.read_dt AS readDate, COALESCE( ( SELECT al.approver_name FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY al.approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1 ), '-' ) AS currentApproverName, CAST(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id ) AS SIGNED) AS totalApproverCount, CAST(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status <> 'PENDING' ) AS SIGNED) AS doneApproverCount, CAST((CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id ) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( ( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status <> 'PENDING' ) * 100.0 ) / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id ), 0 ) END) AS SIGNED) AS progressPercent FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE
ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ea.approval_id) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al2.approval_seq < al.approval_seq )

SELECT DISTINCT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_id AS docId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus, ea.drafter_name AS drafterName, ea.department_name AS departmentName, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al2.approval_seq < al.approval_seq ) ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ea1.approval_id) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea1 JOIN approval_line al1 ON al1.approval_id = ea1.approval_id WHERE ea1.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al1.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al1.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea1.approval_id AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al2.approval_seq < al1.approval_seq ) ) AS pendingReviewCount, ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea2 WHERE ea2.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea2.approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'HOLD') ) AS inProgressCount, ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea3 WHERE ea3.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea3.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' AND ea3.approve_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND ea3.approve_dt < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) AS completedThisMonthCount

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ea.approval_id) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al2.approval_seq < al.approval_seq )
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval WHERE drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND approval_status IN ('PENDING', 'HOLD')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval WHERE drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND approval_status = 'COMPLETE' AND approve_dt >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND approve_dt < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT DISTINCT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, ea.drafter_name AS drafterName, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate, al.read_dt AS readDate FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE ea.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_line al2 WHERE al2.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al2.approval_status = 'PENDING' AND al2.approval_seq < al.approval_seq ) ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, COALESCE( ( SELECT al.approver_name FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY al.approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1 ), '-' ) AS currentApproverName, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE ea.drafter_id = #{employeeId} AND ea.approval_status <> 'WITHDRAWN' ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ea.approval_id) AS SIGNED) FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE

ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT DISTINCT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.title AS title, ea.drafter_name AS drafterName, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate FROM electronic_approval ea JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_id = ea.approval_id WHERE
ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size}
